support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs that the registry link be treated as unresolved.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity and DISTINCT requires establishing distinctness; the packet preserves multiple live registry candidates (including a Wyoming LLC from a 2024 credit check) and explicitly states that identity between the billing name and registry:2019-0008841 cannot be established, so neither positive nor negative disposition is licensed.
